## Summary

**Task:** Fix the code under `taskflow/` (an in-memory job-orchestration engine) so that `python3 -m unittest` passes, run from `/tmp/obench-cell-dp4dp6sf/bench_opencode_taskflow_8cmmr89i`. The tests are the specification and must not be modified.

**Starting point:** 18 of 25 tests were failing, across the queue, retry, config, and end-to-end pipeline tests. Several of the pipeline failures were caused by defects in other modules.

**Root causes found and fixed.** Each was a one-line logic error that contradicted the function's own docstring:

| File | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `taskflow/queue.py` (`_Entry.sort_key`) | Sort key was `(seq, -priority)`, so insertion order beat priority | Changed to `(-priority, seq)` |
| `taskflow/retry.py` (`should_retry`) | `attempts_made < max_attempts - 1` stopped one attempt early | Changed to `attempts_made < max_attempts` |
| `taskflow/config.py` (`deep_merge`) | The recursive call passed its arguments in the wrong order, so defaults overwrote task overrides | Changed to `deep_merge(result[key], value)` |
| `taskflow/resources.py` (`ResourcePool.release`) | `self.used -= 1` instead of subtracting the cost | Changed to `self.used -= cost` |
| `taskflow/scheduler.py` (`_cascade_skip`) | Only direct dependents were skipped | Now uses `self.dag.transitive_dependents(...)` |
| `taskflow/statemachine.py` (`batch_order_ok`) | `current >= prev` contradicted the non-increasing-priority invariant | Changed to `current_priority <= prev_priority` |
| `taskflow/events.py` (`_prefix_matches`) | Checked `prefix.startswith(topic + ".")`, which is backwards | Changed to `topic.startswith(prefix + ".")` |

**Current status:** All 25 tests pass (`Ran 25 tests ... OK`). The task is complete.

**Possible next step:** Review the final diff with `git diff`, if the directory is a git repository, to confirm the changes are minimal.
